_README: THE APPLICATION RECORD — layer ④ of four. Answers: WHAT are we applying to?
Copy to storage/_job-listings/<Track>/application.json alongside the listing doc.
Facts about the JOB belong to the JOB — not to a person's profile. Two people
applying to the same posting share ONE of these files, so the apply link, the pay
verdict, and the company palette can never drift apart between them.
Folders are keyed by ROLE TRACK (3D-Visualizer/, Backend/), not by date — so each
new job in a track is a copy-and-tweak of the last, not a rebuild.
roleTitle: The Exact Job Title From The Listing

_statusValues.BLOCKED — no apply link: ⚠ THE DEFAULT. See links.applyUrl below — this is a HARD GATE.
_statusValues.READY TO SUBMIT: Materials generated, bundled, and verified. Apply link confirmed live.
_statusValues.CLOSED: Rejected, withdrawn, or the posting died.

_⚠BLOCKING: CAPTURE THE APPLY URL BEFORE YOU BUILD ANYTHING.
A perfectly tailored application you cannot submit is worthless. This has already
happened twice: a listing was pasted as raw text, nobody recorded where it came
from, and by the time the resume was finished the posting could not be found.
If a listing arrives with no URL -> ASK FOR IT. One question costs nothing.
Status stays BLOCKED until an apply URL or apply email exists.
TRAP: a company page showing 'no open jobs' does NOT mean the posting is dead.
Board postings often never appear on the employer's own page. Only the DIRECT
job link is authoritative — fetch it before concluding anything.
TRAP: job-alert emails wrap the URL in tracking cruft. Keep only the job key;
the session tokens rot and can leak how you found the job.
links.howToApply: portal / email address / job board. If a board hosts the application: upload the LIGHT (ATS) resume PDF, never the merged bundle — a parser fed the bundle reads your cover letter as resume content. Two applicants => two accounts.

terms._note: Verify these EARLY and say so LOUDLY if they are bad. Finding out the pay is below market after building the whole application is a waste of a day.
terms.payVerdict: Convert to hourly AND annual, compare to market for the role and region, and state the verdict plainly. If it is below market, SAY SO.

_⚠BLOCKING: For every listing requirement with NO vault backing: ASK THE PERSON BEFORE BUILDING.
The vault records what they have TOLD you. It is NOT the limit of what they can do.
On a real application, four requirements looked like gaps — and all four turned out
to be long-standing strengths nobody had thought to ask about.
Only a CONFIRMED absence is a gap. Then: name the honest equivalent on the resume,
and address it once, plainly, in the cover letter. That candor wins credibility.
